exercises.hint: Split both versions on ".", convert to numbers, and compare part by part: major, then minor, then patch.
exercises.task: npm compares semver versions to decide what ^ and ~ allow. Write compare(v1, v2): return 1 if v1 is newer, -1 if v1 is older, 0 if they're equal. (Careful: compare numerically, not as strings!)

exercises.hint: Check pkg.name is a non-empty string, and test pkg.version against a digits-dot-digits-dot-digits pattern like 1.4.2.
exercises.task: Validate a package.json object: print "valid" if it has a non-empty name and a version matching the pattern digits.digits.digits (e.g. "1.4.2"); otherwise print "invalid".

exercises.hint: Object.entries(deps) gives [name, version] pairs. Loop over them and print each install line.
exercises.starterCode:
const deps = { lodash: "^4.17.21", jest: "^29.7.0" };
// TODO: for each dependency, print "installing <name>@<version>"
exercises.task: Simulate npm install: given a dependencies object, print one line per package in the form "installing <name>@<version>".
